scope_quotes: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.scope_text: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity, except for married names as provided in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
context_quotes: see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)
alternative_quotes: Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees;
Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
unit_attributes.choice_text: Submission of one or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.logic_text: one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.object_quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object: material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.summary: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more listed acceptable documents: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees), certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage.

concepts.label: Material Discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
